title: SE3 Struct: compose, inverse, act
hints: Compose: (R1, t1)·(R2, t2) = (R1 R2, R1 t2 + t1). Write p_a = R1 (R2 p + t2) + t1 and read it off.
Inverse: p_a = R p_b + t  ⇒  p_b = Rᵀ(p_a − t). So the inverse is (Rᵀ, −Rᵀ t). Don't invert a 4×4.
matrix(): start from Matrix4d::Identity(), then write the topLeftCorner<3,3>() and topRightCorner<3,1>() blocks.
